purpose: Records with no committed table-backend cache. Re-extracting one needs a paid Azure Document Intelligence call, so the pipeline refuses by default (LLOYDS_ALLOW_TABLE_BACKEND_CALLS=1 lifts it) and these are left as they are.
round: round 56 (the consolidated external review of 11 September 2026)
decision: The owner declined the calls on 11 September 2026. Every one of these records already carries no prior-year development figure, so none is in the working sample and none contributes to any result in the paper. Buying a grid for them could only change that by admitting a record that is absent today, which is a sample change, not a correction.
note: syndicate_1176_2022_azure is not a record at all: it is an Azure cache file committed into the records directory rather than into azure_output, which is why the directory holds one more file than the corpus holds records. It is left where it is because moving a tracked file is not this round's business.
